summary.text: Johnnie Townsend is the Republican candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as retail.

paragraphs.text: Townsend earned a high school diploma from John J. Pershing High School and attended Oakland Community College, and his career experience includes working in retail.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father of four and grandfather of six with more than a decade of community involvement.
Townsend advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
He named mental health care, including opening facilities, education investment and school safety, and healthcare reform with flexible, individually tailored plans as his key campaign messages.
